# GoodSiteDevelopment

> Fullstack development, product design, AI agents and DevOps. We take responsibility for the whole path: from the first sketch to production metrics. Moscow. GoodSiteDevelopment is a developer with 20 years of experience and a product designer who has shipped dozens of interfaces. You talk to the people who write the code and draw the screens.

Key facts: 20 years in development; 100/100 Lighthouse on shipped projects; 2 people, no juniors; 6 languages on this site.

## Services

- Fullstack development: Web applications and services from prototype to production.
- Product UI/UX design: Product design, design systems and clickable prototypes.
- Telegram WebApp and bots: Mini apps and bots that live inside Telegram.
- AI agents and RAG: Agents, company knowledge search, self-hosted models.
- Architecture and DevOps: Infrastructure as code, CI/CD, containers, monitoring.
- Audit and performance: 100/100/100/100 in Lighthouse without losing features.
- Microservices and BFF: Splitting a monolith, backend-for-frontend, integrations.
- Technical consulting: A second opinion on architecture, hiring and code.
